title: Identification of two robust subclasses of sepsis with both prognostic and therapeutic values based on machine learning analysis.

models.outcome_definition: survivor vs non-survivor (28-day in E-MTAB-4451/GSE65682/GSE95233/E-MTAB-4421/E-MTAB-7581; in-hospital death with uncertain cutoff in GSE185263)
models.expression_scale_used: merged GEO/ArrayExpress data, probe-mean gene symbols, batch-corrected with sva/ComBat across cohorts (exact scale unclear)
models.reported_performance: Risk score AUC 0.666 (training, n=980) and 0.608 (validation, n=760); 28d-cutoff cohorts AUC 0.681 training / 0.603 validation; GSE185263 AUC 0.616; GSE95233 0.626. Multivariable OR 2.704 (training), 2.007 (validation).
models.source_location: Methods 'Development of signature related to sepsis survival'; Results 'Risk score construction'; Figure 6C; Supplementary Table S7 (coefficients)

models.outcome_definition: Adaptive vs Inflammatory subtype; Inflammatory associated with higher mortality in training set
models.expression_scale_used: sva-corrected merged expression of 90 sepsis-related DEGs
models.reported_performance: Training clusters: dead 94/442 (A) vs 145/538 (B), chi-square P=0.044 (Table S5)
models.source_location: Methods 'K-means clustering analysis'; Results; Table S5

notes: Formula in Methods literally reads risk score=log{0.941*sum(coef x exp)}; constant 0.941 and log unexplained. Coefficients from Table S7 (logistic). Text ORs: ITK OR 1.423 (risk) consistent with positive coef. Discovery for WGCNA/clustering = 7 cohorts (GSE54514, GSE57065, GSE65682, GSE131761, E-MTAB-4451, GSE185263, GSE134347); risk-score training listed as GSE54514, E-MTAB-4451, GSE65682, GSE185263, GSE131761 (abstract says four datasets, n=980). Subtype validation: E-MTAB-7581, GSE13015(GPL6947), GSE95233, E-MTAB-5273, GSE33341. GSE110487 used for therapy-response analysis. The 90 clustering genes are not listed in text (no full gene list for the subtype model). GSE185263, GSE54514, GSE65682, GSE95233 all used -> ineligible for evaluating this model.
